whatsNew.title: What's New in TeleDrive
features: Device Backup & Sync Stability — resilient auto-mirroring with rate-limit and freeze protection
Official Android & Mobile Support — native touch interface and responsive cross-platform sync
Modern File & Code Previewer — responsive mobile layout, syntax highlighting, word wrap & quick actions
Security & Storage Hardening — SHA-256 folder digests, atomic credential vault, and strict zero-trust CSP
Multi-Language Parity — 11 languages with 100% native translations and localized drive terminology
